source_text:
5.9 Κύριε, ὁδήγησόν με ἐν τῇ δικαιο σύνῃ σου, ε νεκα τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου. ̓Εν
τῇ κατὰ πρακτικὴν δικαιοσύνῃ ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ. –Τῶν ἐχθρῶν. Τῶν νοητῶν δη
λονότι· πολλοὶ γὰρ οἱ ἐπιβουλεύοντες τῇ θεοφιλεῖ ψυχῇ, τῇ κατὰ Θεὸν αὐτῆς προ
κοπῇ διαβασκαίνοντες.
pass_a_gloss: Lord, lead-me in the righteousness of-you, because-of the enemies of-me. In the according-to-practice righteousness in the Christ. Of-the enemies. Of-the intelligible-ones clearly; for many [are] the ones-plotting-against the God-loving soul, the according-to-God of-it progress begrudging.
pass_b_english: “Lord, lead me in your righteousness, because of my enemies” (Psalm 5:9).

In the righteousness according to practice, in Christ. — “Of my enemies.” The intelligible ones, clearly; for many are those who plot against the God-loving soul, begrudging its progress according to God.

choices.why: Lock prints ε νεκα: OCR split of ἕνεκα, not ἐν ἐκα.
πρακτική is the practical/ascetic life, not ‘actual’ or a legal active-righteousness slogan.
Masculine with ἐχθρῶν: intelligible enemies, not ‘intelligible things’.
OCR προ κοπῇ is προκοπή, not κοπή/cutting or κόπος.
διαβασκαίνω = envy/begrudge the dative προκοπῇ. Not διαβαίνω ‘passing through’.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
